probe_finding: Definition as established in the 2026-10-15 read: WOPR (Weighted Opportunity Rating) is Josh Hermsmeyer's (@friscojosh) opportunity metric combining a receiver's target share and air-yards share into one number; charted by @StephenKrupka as TPRR vs WOPR for WRs and TEs (data: TruMedia; chart minimums: 20 WOPR / 10 routes run). Stamped instances (Week 5 TE edition): B. Bowers ~0.34 TPRR / ~67 WOPR (top-right); P. Freiermuth ~0.27 / ~62; C. Loveland and D. Kincaid low (~0.13-0.18 TPRR, ~30-40 WOPR). Week 5 WR edition leaders per the author's text: Germie Bernard, Puka Nacua (24 targets), Mike Evans; Jaylen Waddle lagging. Role in-engine: WOPR is the opportunity half of the receiver economy — tonight's seam premise (P-SEA-DEN-015) resolves on TE+RB target share, which is WOPR's input layer.
